## Design

### 2026-10-20 – In this session, I came up with and sketched up a design for my MindfieldMania MP3 player.

**3h**

In this session, I came up with and sketched up a design for my MindfieldMania MP3 player.

![IdeaSketch](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/db9c420f4a7ee31aa32928d1a883d54efd533bb850fcad05f1d738c8b69932cb.jpg)

It is going to play Vsauce's mindfield intro on the click of a button. I will use this for the moments when someone says something really deep and needs recognition for their vsaucity.

It will use a DFPlayer to play the intro, paired with an arduino nano to control it.

![DFPlayer](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/f0a67687e3f847204d973dd1d1bf1d299fe929b24ce1796c7a82354ef3653cf8.png)

For my previous 2 projects, I was able to use a USB cable to power the boards. In this project - as the player will be portable - I will use a 18650 lithium battery paired with a TP4056 charge board and an MT3607 voltage booster to power the system. I ordered these parts, after doing some research and selecting them.

![Screenshot 2026-10-20 180754](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/97608a8df40097cd54fe0178fcce566df846959acf5ee93c7b8756e82dbe1d3a.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-20 180808](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/04b5db878facd5fb9b99df4f831ff5ea844c485694e65e1ffb5884c44a602693.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-20 185626](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/3f72a27dcb20fbcf35da16efd7a6a7c17943c1c7974b7f105973f419cd3bb973.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-20 185641](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/59320198abadebcc69cfe684b5e1fac5705fc4c6b5ede826844f357a9e67fd2f.png)

Next steps are making the schematic, ordering  the DFPlayer, speaker, and button, and finding some code to fit my needs.

### 2026-10-22 – In this session, I made a case for the electronics in CAD. The basis of the design is a hexagon with filleted edges. There is a hole at the top for the 76mm speaker to fit in.

**4h**

In this session, I made a case for the electronics in CAD. The basis of the design is a hexagon with filleted edges. There is a hole at the top for the 76mm speaker to fit in.
Oh yeah I finally found one that will be big, and work with the DFPlayer's on board amp.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 173638](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/baced05690ba8e9ca4ba588cf5d12ef9deda70e0c0ccfb594922b986d1fdefb4.png)

 There's also a hole for the USB charging port to go in, and a couple holes for switches. (One to turn on and off and one to play sound.)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 172420](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/5183d3b9f9643c556cb726cb934c109de24066127020e3c15adf005b266608ac.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 172717](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/eb26db4b9f46ed6756ee688123098ee600db2292be20ba435ade4164e20febf4.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 173005](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/325d4c4e606799e3138ea5c732fd45d41844b9691f54c184ba335af7d4231c24.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 173508](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/280ebd6234ced8d6abb6db44564df110ab6d48f8d7838ebf845f5a99ce03f712.png)

I might have to change the size of the box, depending on how big the speaker is. The info on Jaycar's website doesn't give much information so I may go in and check with them later in the week. I looked at some code options online and I will likely adapt someone elses code. Or... it might finally be time for me to learn some Arduino IDE. I think it all depends on how much time I have.

### 2026-10-23 – I made a list of connections based on the BOM, in preparation for making the schematic. The routing doc was split into two halves: the DFPlayer system and the power system.

**3h**

I made a list of connections based on the BOM, in preparation for making the schematic. The routing doc was split into two halves: the DFPlayer system and the power system.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 163902](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/50ea2d235c977c204c3a1d80c8e64e8f8f4f7617a28bf403fb79c61051846079.png)

Using the routing doc, I made a schematic for the arduino nano, the DFPlayer, and its speaker. I did not include the power system because it is difficult to represent in the schematic and there weren't necessary parts.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 165158](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/34ecde63cdae76fdb9d6b2b92a5ecb03bf3ecae49682877ea6b1ec1c3652bba4.png)

Here is the finished schematic:

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 165931](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/0eef0b615948febf11d23122962e0afb844a0529fa8d27801fe6be3db12a2f7c.png)

You can find the .json file in my Github Repo.
